thread:
mohit: Quick docs PR up - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812. Adding a short 'provisioning playbook' with tenant quota, canary, and a tiny terraform var example. PTAL?

elaine: Skimmed. A couple micro-nits on phrasing and one link anchor changed for autoscale policies. Also can we add a CLI terraform vars snippet so infra folks can copy-paste?

mohit: Good idea. I'll add a short terraform example in the 'onboard' section. YAML or HCL?

sam: HCL is ideal for a terraform snippet but keep the YAML snippet too for the playbook example. Also prefer the wording 'tenant isolation window' vs 'isolation period'. Left that inline.

julia: Can we include a small curl for test traffic to validate canary routing on staging? That saves a ton of back-and-forth.

mohit: Added both. Draft snippets below:

```yaml
# provisioning-mini-playbook.yml
tenant:
  id: example-tenant
  quota:
    gpu_hours_per_day: 24
    max_concurrent_requests: 100
canary:
  percent_of_traffic: 5
  duration_minutes: 30
  fallback_policy: 'route-to-hosted'
```

```hcl
# terraform.tfvars example
tenant_id = "example-tenant"
gpu_hours_per_day = 24
max_concurrent_requests = 100
```

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \ \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \ \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \
  -d '{"model":"ggml-1","input":"hello world","tenant":"example-tenant"}'
```

elaine: Awesome. I'll update the autoscale anchor to /docs/autoscale-policies#scale-policy-refs and add a short note in the playbook about expected latency changes when enabling KV cache (brief: warms quickly but initial latency may spike).

dev-doc-bot: checklist run: link-check OK, spell-check 0 issues, preview built at https://deploy-preview-812--docs.redwood.ai

sam: If CI is green and the wording fixes land, I'll merge. @julia can you confirm the curl payload matches staging?

julia: Confirmed earlier  returned 200 and I saw x-rw-canary: true on ~5% of runs. KV cache warmed after a few requests. :rocket:

mohit: Thanks all. I'll push edits in 10m and merge if no objections.
